title: Bob the Builder builds a playground.
lines: He wears a yellow helmet and blue overalls.
Bob works with his friend Wendy.
Muck is the red dumper truck.
And Dizzy is the orange cement mixer.
Bob, the children don't have a playground.
They drive to a big empty field.
First the field has to be made flat.
Muck takes them away in his big bucket.
He makes the ground nice and flat.
Rock and roll, rock and roll!
The cement comes out for the feet of the swing.
Bob and Wendy build the swing.
But then it starts to rain.
The field turns into a mud bath.
He puts big planks on the mud.
Now the machines can drive over it.
They keep working in the rain.
Working in the rain isn't so bad at all.
There's a rainbow over the new playground.
Wendy plants some flowers around the fence.
They swing high into the air.
They build castles in the sandpit.
Dizzy wants to go down the slide too.
The mayor thanks Bob and his team.
Bob takes off his helmet and smiles.
